description: Year-10 subject-selection panel: update the note text in renderStudentSubjectsPanel to include the student's stream name when a Year-10 student with no subjects is viewing the panel. canChoose(10) already returns true and saveChooseSubjects already saves with status:'effective', so no data-layer change is needed. This is a one-line cosmetic fix.
steps: Read src/views/student.js renderStudentSubjectsPanel (~line 113-166). Identify the final else-branch (no effective subjects) where note.textContent is set to 'Pick your subjects for this ...'.
Before that note line, derive streamLabel: `const streamLabel = cl?.stream ? ` (${cl.stream} stream)` : '';`
Change the note.textContent to: `Pick your subjects for ${Data.session().name}${streamLabel} — your choice takes effect immediately.`
Run `npm run build` and confirm zero errors.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build produces zero errors
A Year-10 student with no subjects sees 'Pick your subjects for ... (Science stream) — your choice takes effect immediately.' (or without stream suffix if class has no stream set)
The 'Choose subjects' button label is unchanged (already correct in the existing code)
findings: One-line change in renderStudentSubjectsPanel's final else-branch: derived streamLabel from cl?.stream and updated note.textContent. Build passes with zero errors. The cl variable was already in scope from line ~125.
